children: Japanese stocks may rise after Friday's selloffs and solid U.S. jobs data. Nikkei futures are up 1.1% at 58220 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.37 yen, compared with Y157.92 as of Friday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on corporate earnings as well as any developments in the Middle East. Mitsui O.S.K. Lines is set to announce its results later Monday. The Nikkei Stock Average fell 6.0% to 57434.77 on Friday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
